wayfarer.compass.air: the eyes do not answer in the air
wayfarer.compass.shelter.fire: the fire's circle: nothing comes near
wayfarer.compass.shelter.shrine: a hallowed hall: nothing is born here
wayfarer.ember.awake: The ember wakes. It pulls towards the nearest shard.
wayfarer.fire.silence: The fire settles. %s says nothing more tonight.
wayfarer.fire.warm: The ember warms at your fire. Until tomorrow's dusk it burns the fire, not your food.
wayfarer.first.dawn: The gaze looks away at dawn, and what it sent crumbles under the open sky. In caves and shadow it waits for night.
wayfarer.first.death: The road keeps your things under a stone where you fell, each in its place. Your compass marks it.
wayfarer.first.portal: Obsidian takes no spark. The Keepers sealed the world below.
wayfarer.first.shrine: The Twelve Peoples hallowed their halls: no monster is born here, and no horde follows you in.
wayfarer.first.waystone: The first Wayfarers set these stones along their roads. One folds the road back to any stone you have touched, so it only carries you along roads you have walked.
wayfarer.gate.incomplete: The frame stays cold. Your ember holds %s of %s shards.
wayfarer.gate.ward: The Keepers' ward holds: the frame will not take the Eye while a Gazebound stands in the hall.
wayfarer.gaze.lifted: The dragon is dead. The ember goes out, and the sky is yours.
wayfarer.gaze.title: Dragon's Gaze
wayfarer.gaze.veil: Ember Veil %s: %s min in the air
wayfarer.lead.mark.hover: Show this place on your compass
wayfarer.lead.unmark.hover: Stop showing this place on your compass
wayfarer.lead.untold: Nobody has told you the way there yet.
wayfarer.night.blood_moon.chat: Monsters walk thick and strong tonight, and your fire does not frighten them. Reach your tent before dark.
wayfarer.night.blood_moon.subtitle: Tonight the moon is the Eye.
wayfarer.night.blood_moon.title: A Red Dawn
wayfarer.night.both.chat: Blood moon and horde together: no bed, no tent, no fire's circle, stronger monsters. Shelter in a shrine or prepare today.
wayfarer.night.both.subtitle: A red moon and the full gaze.
wayfarer.night.both.title: Red and Sleepless
wayfarer.night.ejected: The tent unfolds around you. The ember burns too bright to hide tonight.
wayfarer.night.horde.chat: Tonight nobody sleeps, no tent opens and the horde walks through fire. Shelter in a shrine, or be ready by dusk.
wayfarer.night.horde.subtitle: Tonight the gaze turns fully.
wayfarer.night.horde.title: A Sleepless Night
wayfarer.night.no_sleep: The gaze has turned fully towards the world. Nobody sleeps tonight.
wayfarer.night.tent: The ember burns too bright to fold away tonight.
wayfarer.shrine.claimed: %s took up the %s. Shards in your ember: %s.
wayfarer.shrine.memory: The shard remembers: %s. It is copied into your journal.
wayfarer.shrine.silent: The pedestal is cold. No shard ever rested here.
wayfarer.shrine.sinks: The shard sinks into your ember for good. Nothing can take it out again, not even death.
wayfarer.shrine.spent: The %s already travels with your fire.
wayfarer.shrine.stirs: Two shards touch in your ember, and something stirs. Sit by your fire tonight.
wayfarer.stillness.dimming: The ember is dimming. It wants the road.
wayfarer.stillness.found: The gaze has found you. It comes tonight.
wayfarer.unlock.aircraft: The sky is closed to you. It opens at %s eyes.
wayfarer.unlock.sailing_ships: The sea does not carry you yet. It opens at %s eyes.
